extra.message: Login CSRF — POST /api/auth/login lacks csrf_protect dependency

metadata.citation: def login(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict[str, Any]:
metadata.proof: SOURCE: attacker-controlled web page can issue a cross-origin POST to /api/auth/login with the attacker's own credentials. SINK: the handler at line 623 creates an authenticated session and sets session_token + csrf_token cookies via set_auth_cookies(). No csrf_protect dependency guards this POST (contrast with every other state-changing route). Impact: victim is silently logged into the attacker's account; subsequent actions (viewing orders, disputes, payouts) are attributed to the attacker's account, potentially leaking the victim's private data.

extra.message: Dispute Status Transition Bypass via Message Posting

metadata.proof: The PATCH /api/disputes/{id}/status endpoint (line 1682) enforces valid_dispute_transition() which only allows resolved->closed transitions.
